text:
Tess: Quick heads-up — eng-platform is proposing a small rename in the route hint header from `X-RW-Route` to `X-RW-RouteHint`. It touches SDKs and the console mapping. @sam can you confirm the rationale?
Sam: Yep. We want to separate tenant routing (auth-backed) vs ephemeral policy hints used by the router. No perf change, mostly semantics and clearer intent.
Liam: Will this break billing attribution or quota dashboards? worried about exports and historical joins.
Sam: Plan is to implement transparent aliasing at the gateway for ~6 weeks so both headers are accepted, and to emit a telemetry label `route_hint.v2` during the canary window so the console can detect adoption.
Ara: For SDKs (py/ts/go) I propose adding a new param `route_hint_header` and keep `route_header` as deprecated for one release with a runtime shim. That gives customers a smooth upgrade path.
Tess: Good. We also need a short migration doc, a console UX note (how the route column will display), and a small example for quickstarts.
Sam: Draft migration snippet below — easy to copy into docs: 
```py
# old
client = Redwood(api_key=KEY, route_header="X-RW-Route")
# new
client = Redwood(api_key=KEY, route_hint_header="X-RW-RouteHint")
```
Liam: On the console side: we'll add a mapped field `route_hint` in billing exports and in the per-route dashboard. Mapping old->new is straightforward but needs ~2 dev hours and a small DB migration for the export view.
Jun: For telemetry validation during canary, can SDKs emit a special event `route_hint_migration` when they start sending the new header? that would make adoption dashboards trivial.
Ara: Yes, we can add an opt-in telemetry toggle (default off) in SDKs so early adopters in the canary cohort can opt-in. Then we flip it on in SDK releases for a week while we watch console metrics.
Sam: Proposed timeline: aliasing + telemetry label goes live next Monday (gateway change), SDK patches open Tue/Wed, notify customers Thu with migration guide, full deprecation of the old header after 6 weeks if metrics look good.
Tess: Action items: Ara open SDK PRs and a short CHANGELOG migration snippet; Liam update console mapping & export view; Sam owns gateway alias + telemetry label; Jun will add the adoption metric to the console tile. I'll ping enterprise leads separately.
sdk-ci-bot: CI checks passing on py and ts patches :tada: 
Liam: One more ask — add a tiny note in the rollout UX: when both headers are present prefer `route_hint` and surface a warning in the console for 4 weeks so SREs see mixed signals.
Sam: Agreed, we can emit a low-severity warning metric.
Tess: Thanks all. I'll collate these into a short release checklist and post in #eng-platform tomorrow.
